news.title: Olympian choses Minnesota for best-in-nation academics and athletics
news.summary_en: For Josefin Bouveng — Swedish Olympian and Gopher hockey player — the University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering scores high for “great hockey program and great education.”

news.title: Three CSE students awarded Astronaut Scholarships
news.summary_en: Three College of Science and Engineering students were awarded 2026-27 Astronaut Scholarships: Aletta Bartok, Henry Kopp and Ahmed Sharara.
